ValidationRule.description: Validates that the account Billing State/Province is a valid two-character abbreviation if Billing Country is CA.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( OR(BillingCountry = "CA"), OR( LEN(BillingState) <> 2, NOT( CONTAINS("AB:BC:MB:NB:NL:NT:NS:NU:ON:PC:QC:SK:YT", BillingState) )))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A valid two-letter province code is required.
